findings.title: Low CSS color contrast ratio: 1.84:1
findings.problem: Foreground color #b8b8b8 on background #f7f7f7 provides only 1.84:1 contrast ratio.
findings.impact: Users with low vision cannot distinguish text from surface backgrounds.
findings.solution: Adjust text color to #334155 to exceed the WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 ratio.

fix.explanation: Updated text color from #b8b8b8 to high-contrast #334155.

findings.title: Image missing required alt text
findings.problem: The element is missing an alt attribute.
findings.impact: Screen reader users will not understand the context or purpose of this graphic.
findings.solution: Add a concise, descriptive alt attribute.
findings.evidence: No alt attribute found on tag.

fix.diff: --- a/index.html +++ b/index.html @@ -8,1 +8,1 @@ - +
fix.explanation: Added descriptive alt attribute to image element.

findings.title: Form input lacks accessible label or id
findings.problem: The <input> field does not specify an aria-label or an id associated with a <label>.
findings.impact: Assistive technologies cannot announce the expected input for this field.
findings.solution: Link an explicit <label for="id"> or add aria-label="Your work email".
findings.evidence: Missing label pairing on email input.

fix.diff:
--- a/index.html
+++ b/index.html
@@ -13,1 +13,1 @@
-      <input type="email" placeholder="Your work email">
+      <input aria-label="Your work email" type="email" placeholder="Your work email">
fix.explanation: Added accessible aria-label to input field.

findings.title: Focus outline removed without replacement
findings.problem: CSS declares 'outline: none' removing native focus indicators.
findings.impact: Keyboard navigation becomes impossible as users cannot visually track focused controls.
findings.solution: Provide an accessible custom focus ring (e.g. outline: 2px solid var(--primary); outline-offset: 2px).
findings.evidence: outline: none detected without replacement focus style.

fix.explanation: Replaced outline: none with visible 2px focus ring.

findings.title: Hardcoded fixed container width: 1200px
findings.problem: Hardcoded fixed width of 1200px will overflow screens on narrower viewports.
findings.impact: Induces horizontal layout scrolling and clips content on mobile devices.
findings.solution: Use max-width: 1200px; width: 100%; instead of rigid pixel widths.
findings.evidence: Fixed width constraint of 1200px without fluid container fallback.

fix.explanation: Converted rigid width to responsive max-width: 1200px.

findings.title: Sub-minimum font size: 10px
findings.problem: Text font size is set to 10px, below the recommended 12px minimum.
findings.impact: Severely impairs readability for users with low vision or on mobile screens.
findings.solution: Increase base font size to at least 13px.

findings.title: Ambiguous action copy: 'Click here'
findings.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match Between System and the Real World
findings.problem: The button label 'Click here' lacks context about what happens next.
findings.impact: Users hesitate when interacting with action controls.
findings.solution: Replace 'Click here' with an explicit descriptive action like 'Save and Continue'.
findings.evidence: Generic text 'Click here' used as button content.

fix.explanation: Updated vague button text to 'Save and Continue'.
